name: Yureru Omoi ~Triangle Love Story~
source:
Kotaro Hito is a student who left Kobe for Tokyo alone to enter university. He has left the girl of his love interest in Kobe but in Tokyo there even more temptations. The love story over two cities begins now. 

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/10/vn-of-month-january-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
